findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/Lattice.lean:213: theorem mem_inf {p q : Submodule R M} {x : M} : x ∈ p ⊓ q ↔ x ∈ p ∧ x ∈ q
findings.fix: Replace it with `rw [typeASpecialLinearFixedOffDiagonal, Submodule.mem_inf, mem_specialLinearOffDiagonal_iff, LinearMap.mem_fixedSubmodule_iff]` (or the `simp only` equivalent), which also removes the manual two-direction `constructor` block.
findings.issue: `change X ∈ specialLinearOffDiagonal … ∧ _ ↔ _` in `mem_typeASpecialLinearFixedOffDiagonal_iff` relies on `⊓` membership being an `∧` by definition, with no comment explaining why.

findings.evidence: `sl` is a `LinearMap.ker` of the trace map in Mathlib.Algebra.Lie.Classical; the `change` crosses that wrapper by defeq.
findings.fix: Use `rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]` (plus `Matrix.traceLinearMap_apply`) before the `simp`, or add a comment justifying the unfolding.
findings.issue: `change Matrix.trace _ = 0` in `specialLinearOffDiagonalEquiv.invFun` relies on `sl` being defined as the kernel of the trace map, with no comment.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Basis/Defs.lean:280: theorem Basis.coe_ofEquivFun [Finite ι] [DecidableEq ι] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] ι → R)
findings.fix: Rewrite with `Module.Basis.coe_ofEquivFun`, then `specialLinearOffDiagonalEquiv_symm_apply` and an entrywise `ext`/`simp`, which removes both the `change` and the helper `have`.
findings.issue: `specialLinearOffDiagonalBasis_apply` uses an uncommented `change` that relies on `specialLinearOffDiagonalEquiv` being definitionally equal to matrix-entry evaluation, then detours through `repr_self` and a large `simp`.

summary: Three `change` steps rely on undocumented definitional unfolding (Submodule inf membership, `sl` as trace kernel, basis-vs-coordinate-equiv evaluation) where available Mathlib rewrites would do. The rest of the proofs read robustly.
